6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: Several days had passed since I ordered the investigation into my secretary, Livia Suno.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: Several days had passed since the confrontation with Petr, Livia and Lucian in my office.

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: Lucian was still acting frosty towards me for rejecting his advice. On the other hand, both Petr and Livia were unnaturally nice to me, though they avoided speaking to each other.

9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: Both Petr and Livia had been acting unnaturally nice to me, believing I'd let them off the hook for their affair. They seemed to be avoiding each other in the hallways, though.

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: I was just settling in behind my desk when Lucian knocked on my door.

13.speaker: Player_Italic
13.text: Motion for him to come in.

16.speaker: Narrator
16.text: He entered my office and closed the door behind him.

17.speaker: Narrator
17.text: Lucian entered my office and closed the door behind him.

21.speaker: Lucian Galade
21.text: "I still believe you were wrong not to pursue an investigation into Miss Suno. However, I acknowledge my lack of concrete evidence and unorthodox information gathering method may have given you pause."

22.speaker: Player
22.text: "Unorthodox? You surveilled Petr behind my back!"

23.speaker: Player
23.text: "You're not going to change my mind about this."

24.speaker: Player
24.text: "I could have been less rude to you about it, though."

26.speaker: Lucian Galade
26.text: "I feel I would be failing in my duties as a chief strategist not to give you one last piece of advice on this."

28.speaker: Lucian Galade
28.text: "I have already apologized to Mr. Vectern for the intrusion. It won't happen again."

29.speaker: Narrator
29.text: Lucian looked me in the eye.

30.speaker: Lucian Galade
30.text: "Please, consider dismissing Miss Suno from her position at the palace. Just in case I am right after all."

31.speaker: Player
31.text: "Are you crazy? She'll go public about the affair."

32.speaker: Player
32.text: "I can't. She's so good at her job!"

33.speaker: Player
33.text: "Well, she has been a distraction to Petr..."

34.speaker: Player
34.text: "How do I justify that to her?"

35.speaker: Lucian Galade
35.text: "She slept with the vice president. Extremely unprofessional behavior."

36.speaker: Lucian Galade
36.text: "Her looks may be unmatched, but her skills most certainly are not."

37.speaker: Lucian Galade
37.text: "That might make a headline or two, but it won't sink your administration. Unlike a potential uncontrolled intelligence leak to Rumburg."

38.speaker: Player
38.text: "All right. If it'll get you off my case, I'll fire her."

39.speaker: Player
39.text: "No. I won't continue to indulge your paranoid fantasies. Livia stays."

40.speaker: Lucian Galade
40.text: "Keeping Mr. Vectern around may be another mistake. But that's a conversation for another time."

43.speaker: Narrator
43.text: Lucian looked as if he was about to object one last time, but then smiled thinly.

44.speaker: Lucian Galade
44.text: "As you wish. I won't bring this up any further."

45.speaker: Narrator
45.text: He walked out and closed the door behind him.

46.speaker: Narrator
46.text: I called Livia into my office. She tentatively stepped in.

48.speaker: Narrator
48.text: I thought about how useful she'd been to me as a secretary -- and how much she knew about what I'd done.

51.speaker: Livia Suno
51.text: "W-what? I thought we'd been over all this..."

52.speaker: Livia Suno
52.text: "Um... okay. Just let me know if you need anything."

53.speaker: Player
53.text: "You're making Petr too distracted to work."

54.speaker: Narrator
54.text: Livia walked back out. Lucian looked at me in disbelief for a moment, then smiled.

56.speaker: Lucian Galade
56.text: "You've made your point, Mr. President. I won't trouble you with this any further."

57.speaker: Player
57.text: "You're too ambitious for this job. Go get a proper university education."

58.speaker: Player
58.text: "I don't share Lucian's suspicions that you're a spy, but I can't take the risk that he's right."

61.speaker: Narrator
61.text: She glared at Lucian, then at me.

64.speaker: Livia Suno
64.text: "That's the best you could come up with?"

65.speaker: Livia Suno
65.text: "I hope you're both happy. You've ruined a woman's career simply because she acted too much like a man."

66.speaker: Narrator
66.text: She stormed out, slamming the door behind her.

68.speaker: Lucian Galade
68.text: "Trust me, Mr. President, your decision was the correct one."

70.speaker: Player
70.text: "Stop talking. Don't make this worse than it is."

72.speaker: Narrator
72.text: I showed him out and went to brew myself a pot of coffee.

77.speaker: Lucian Galade
77.text: "Our security team travelled to Lachaven to speak to the owners of the pub Miss Suno named. They confirmed that one Livia Suno had worked there."

78.speaker: Lucian Galade
78.text: "Their description of her did not match that of your secretary."

79.speaker: Lucian Galade
79.text: "However, it did match that of an unidentified corpse that washed up in Lenkurg Bay two months before your inauguration."

81.speaker: Player
81.text: "If that was Livia Suno... who's the woman working for me?"

83.speaker: Lucian Galade
83.text: "Further investigation by our operatives in Rumburg matched Miss Suno's description to a woman named Ilana Vance, last seen graduating from Crimsrad Political Sciences Institute."

87.speaker: Lucian Galade
87.text: "Our whistleblower from Rumburg recognized the name Vance as belonging to a deeply embedded covert agent, although he had previously assumed it was a man."

88.speaker: Lucian Galade
88.text: "Recent coded transmissions from Rumburg have mentioned a deeply embedded covert agent named Vance, but our intelligence always assumed it was a man."

89.speaker: Player
89.text: "How could we have missed all this?"

90.speaker: Player
90.text: "My God. You were right. I should never have doubted you."

92.speaker: Lucian Galade
92.text: "As mentioned, Miss Suno was hired without a background check. It's possible this all could have been avoided, had any of Mr. Vectern's blood flow been directed to his brain when he selected her."

93.speaker: Lucian Galade
93.text: "To be fair, Miss Suno was just doing her job. Your vice president, on the other hand..."

94.speaker: Lucian Galade
94.text: "The standard procedure would be to try Miss Suno for espionage. If we do so, it's only a matter of time before the media pieces together what happened."

95.speaker: Player
95.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Accepted_MediaDeal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Detained_MarcelKoronti"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Marcel_Enemy"] == false

96.speaker: Player
96.text: "You should have figured this out ages ago."

98.speaker: Lucian Galade
98.text: "I'm happy to hear that. Now, what are you going to do, sir?"

99.speaker: Lucian Galade
99.text: "But none of that can be helped now. The question is, what are you going to do, sir?"

100.speaker: Player
100.text: "What do you think I should do?"

101.speaker: Player
101.text: "What do you mean? I'm going to murder them both."

111.speaker: Lucian Galade
111.text: "That would be standard procedure. However, if we do so it's only a matter of time before the media pieces together what happened."

112.speaker: Lucian Galade
112.text: "I wouldn't be opposed to that idea. But I meant with regards to our spy."

113.speaker: Player
113.text: "I'll look like a fool for having her under my nose this entire time."

114.speaker: Player
114.text: "Outwitted by a woman. It won't look good."

119.speaker: Lucian Galade
119.text: "Asking Mr. Koronti for help would be advisable, but you'll still have to do a fair amount of crisis management yourself."

124.speaker: Lucian Galade
124.text: "With the powers granted by your emergency decree, you could certainly detain her without a trial."

126.speaker: Lucian Galade

126.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Order_SecretStatePolice"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_DetentionWithoutTrial"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_DetentionWithoutTrial"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_DetentionWithoutTrial"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Order_SecretStatePolice"] == true)

127.speaker: Lucian Galade
127.text: "Alternately, you could mobilize Mr. Greiser and his men to take care of the situation in secret."

128.speaker: Player
128.text: "You are right. Let's detain her immediately."

129.speaker: Player
129.text: "Good. Let's detain her. And Petr, too -- this was all his fault."

130.speaker: Player
130.text: "No, no. I'd rather do it all above board."

132.speaker: Player
132.text: "No, no. I'd rather do it all above board."

134.speaker: Player
134.text: "Detention without trial sounds like the easiest thing to do."

135.speaker: Player
135.text: "Let's use Karl. The fewer loose ends, the better."

136.speaker: Player
136.text: "No, no. I'd rather do it all above board."

143.speaker: Lucian Galade
143.text: "Then you'd -- what, exactly? Knowingly let her return to Rumburg? That would damage us even further if the truth got out."

149.speaker: Lucian Galade
149.text: "Asking Mr. Koronti for help would be advisable, but you'll still have to do a fair amount of crisis management yourself. Unless you opt to handle this another way."

155.speaker: Lucian Galade
155.text: "That's why you must let Mr. Vectern take the fall."

156.speaker: Lucian Galade
156.text: "You must remain in control of the narrative, Mr. President. Starting by letting Petr Vectern take the fall."

157.speaker: Lucian Galade
157.text: "Starting by letting Petr Vectern take the fall."

160.speaker: Player
160.text: "No. No, I told you, Petr did nothing wrong!"

162.speaker: Player
162.text: "This is my fault as much as his. I should have suspected something."

163.speaker: Player
163.text: "I know you think you'd be a better vice president. But enough is enough."

164.speaker: Lucian Galade
164.text: "You can share the blame, but you have to prepare for your public opinion to nosedive."

165.speaker: Lucian Galade
165.text: "Thankfully, Mr. Koronti can soften that blow."

168.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Accepted_MediaDeal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Detained_MarcelKoronti"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_A_Marcel_Threatened"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Marcel_Enemy"] == false) == false

169.speaker: Lucian Galade
169.text: "Mr. Vectern put you in danger by failing to order a background check on your closest personal staff. He betrayed your confidence to a woman with whom he was committing adultery. Anton, would you do the same to your so-called best friend?"

172.speaker: Lucian Galade
172.text: "Mr. President, rest assured this is not about me."

173.speaker: Lucian Galade
173.text: "But please, take a moment to think about this."
173.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Accepted_MediaDeal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Detained_MarcelKoronti"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_A_Marcel_Threatened"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Marcel_Enemy"] == false) == false

174.speaker: Player
174.text: "For a woman I loved? Maybe I would!"

175.speaker: Player
175.text: "I don't know. I can't put myself in his shoes."

176.speaker: Narrator
176.text: I thought about how useful she'd been to me as a secretary.

180.speaker: Lucian Galade
180.text: "Try guzzling half a bottle of whiskey. That might help."

182.speaker: Lucian Galade
182.text: "If you say so, sir. Are you ready to let Mr. Vectern take the fall?"

183.speaker: Lucian Galade
183.text: "If you say so, sir. Are you ready to let Mr. Vectern take the fall?"

186.speaker: Lucian Galade
186.text: "If you say so, sir. Are you ready to let Mr. Vectern take the fall?"

187.speaker: Lucian Galade
187.text: "I am your chief strategist. I have advised you on what I believe is the best strategy. But of course, the ultimate decision is yours."

188.speaker: Player
188.text: "I will shoulder the blame along with him."

189.speaker: Player
189.text: "All right. Petr will be our scapegoat."

190.speaker: Player
190.text: "I will blame Livia -- I mean, Ilana -- and nobody else."

192.speaker: Narrator
192.text: Lucian looked as if he was about to object one last time, but instead smiled thinly.

193.speaker: Lucian Galade
193.text: "Very well. I shall consult with our friend Mr. Koronti and write a statement for you to read at the press conference. I'll leave you to handle Miss Vance."

202.speaker: Player
202.text: "Great. Let's detain both her and Petr. He got us into this mess, after all."

208.speaker: Player
208.text: "By 'take care of', you mean secretly arrest, right?"

209.speaker: Player
209.text: "By 'take care of', you mean 'take care of for good', right?"

210.speaker: Lucian Galade
210.text: "I think you know precisely what I mean."

218.speaker: Lucian Galade
218.text: "I think you know precisely what I mean."

219.speaker: Lucian Galade
219.text: "It means whatever you want it to mean, sir."

225.speaker: Lucian Galade
225.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_SecretState_Kill_KesaroKibener"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_SecretState_Kill_OrsoHawker"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_SecretState_Kill_FrensRicter"] == true) == false

229.speaker: Lucian Galade
229.text: "I see. Curious that I wasn't informed."

231.speaker: Player
231.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_SecretState_Kill_KesaroKibener"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_SecretState_Kill_OrsoHawker"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_SecretState_Kill_FrensRicter"] == true) == false

232.speaker: Lucian Galade
232.text: "If made to look like an accident, another covert assassination could solve our problem before it even starts. But I understand if you still harbor fond feelings for Miss Vance."

233.speaker: Narrator
233.text: I could almost see the gears in Lucian's head turning.

235.speaker: Player
235.text: "Let's just have her arrested -- and Petr, too, while we're at it. He's done enough harm to this administration."

237.speaker: Player
237.text: "Screw Miss Vance. And Petr too! Let's have them both killed."

243.speaker: Lucian Galade
243.text: "As you wish. I'll call Mr. Greiser right away. It ought to be done by the end of today."

256.text: I called Karl Greiser from my desk and explained the situation. After a few minutes, I rang for Livia.

257.speaker: Livia Suno
257.text: "Is there something you need, Mr. President?"

260.speaker: Player
260.text: "It's been a pleasure working with you, Livia."

261.speaker: Player
261.text: "Yes. I need you to stop pretending."

263.speaker: Narrator
263.text: A barely perceptible flash of fear crossed her face.

265.speaker: Narrator
265.text: A barely perceptible flash of fear crossed her face.

267.speaker: Narrator
267.text: A barely perceptible flash of fear crossed her face. She sat.

268.speaker: Livia Suno
268.text: "Why did you call me in here, sir?"

269.speaker: Narrator
269.text: I nodded toward my office doorway. Karl Greiser was standing there along with two of his guards, blocking the entrance.

270.speaker: Karl Greiser
270.text: "Ilana Vance, you are under arrest on suspicion of espionage. Please come with me."

271.speaker: Narrator
271.text: Her eyes darted around the room.

272.speaker: Livia Suno
272.text: "What the hell is going on? Mr. President, have you let Lucian get to your head? I thought you were smarter than that."

273.speaker: Player
273.text: "You're going to pay for your lies, Ilana."

274.speaker: Player
274.text: "You're going to pay for the way you used Petr."

275.speaker: Player
275.text: "I'm sorry it had to come to this."

276.speaker: Player
276.text: "If you thought I wouldn't trust my closest advisor, you're the stupid one."

277.speaker: Narrator
277.text: Karl's men grabbed her arms and began dragging her out.

278.speaker: Livia Suno
278.text: "No. No! You can't do this to me!"

279.speaker: Petr Vectern
279.text: "Liv? What in the hell!? Anton, what's going on?"

280.speaker: Narrator
280.text: Petr, hearing her cries, rushed out of his office.

281.speaker: Player
281.text: "Her name's Ilana. Lucian was right about her. She's a spy."

282.speaker: Player
282.text: "She was using you all along, Petr."

283.speaker: Player
283.text: "Livia, tell Petr who you really are."

285.speaker: Livia Suno
285.text: "I won't say another word without a lawyer present."

286.speaker: Narrator
286.text: She looked Petr square in the eye.

287.speaker: Livia Suno
287.text: "Except this. You're a sad old drunk and a lousy lay."

288.speaker: Petr Vectern
288.text: "No. That can't be true. Can it? Liv?"

289.speaker: Petr Vectern
289.text: "Liv! Come on, tell them this was all a misunderstanding."

290.speaker: Livia Suno
290.text: "Honestly, if I *were* a Rumburg spy, I'd barely have to do a thing. You two have Sordland ripe for the taking."

291.speaker: Narrator
291.text: She straightened up, ran a hand through her curls and allowed Karl to lead her away.

292.speaker: Narrator
292.text: Petr sank to the floor in front of me.

296.speaker: Narrator
296.text: I waited a few minutes, then rang for Livia.

300.speaker: Karl Greiser
300.text: "No lawyers, ma'am. You're going away for a very long time."

302.speaker: Narrator
302.text: She looked Petr square in the eye.

303.speaker: Livia Suno
303.text: "You're a sad old drunk and a lousy lay."

304.speaker: Livia Suno
304.text: "Honestly, if I *were* a Rumburg spy, I'd barely have to do a thing. You two have Sordland ripe for the taking."

310.speaker: Narrator
310.text: I took a minute to gather my thoughts, then headed out the office. My secretary was outside, typing up some correspondence at her desk.

311.speaker: Player
311.text: "Stepping out for lunch. Hold my calls."

312.speaker: Player
312.text: "I'm so sorry for the misunderstanding with Lucian. You've got a brilliant career ahead of you."

313.speaker: Player
313.text: "Thank you for your hard work, Miss Suno."

315.speaker: Narrator
315.text: She looked at me a bit strangely.

318.speaker: Narrator
318.text: She looked at me a bit strangely.

320.speaker: Narrator
320.text: I took one long, last look at her.

327.speaker: Narrator
327.text: How could I tell him that the worst was still yet to come?

333.speaker: Narrator
333.text: I took a minute to gather my thoughts, then left the room, taking my bottle of Erlory Maroon whiskey with me. My secretary was outside, typing up some correspondence at her desk.

334.speaker: Narrator
334.text: Petr was about to receive some very unpleasant news.

338.speaker: Narrator
338.text: I knocked on the door, and Petr answered. He looked at the bottle of whiskey, then at me.

339.speaker: Petr Vectern
339.text: "Hello there, you two. What's the occasion?"

341.speaker: Player
341.text: "Surviving your affair without a scandal, of course."

342.speaker: Player
342.text: "Do I need an occasion to have a drink with my friend?"

343.speaker: Player
343.text: "I just found this. Forgot I still had it left over from my first day in office."

347.speaker: Narrator
347.text: He brought out two glasses, and I filled them up. We drank in silence for a moment.

348.speaker: Petr Vectern
348.text: "Lucian was right. I've been a miserable excuse for a vice president. But I'm ready to start over."

349.speaker: Petr Vectern
349.text: "No more affairs. No more being late. No more -- well, less drinking."

350.speaker: Petr Vectern
350.text: "I just want to do right by you, Anton. As a colleague and as a friend."

353.speaker: Player
353.text: "You don't need to make it up to me. Our friendship goes too deep for that:"

356.speaker: Narrator
356.text: Petr's eyes had that old sparkle in them again.

359.speaker: Narrator
359.text: I walked out, leaving the bottle on his desk.

360.speaker: Narrator
360.text: I returned home that evening and headed straight to my study, waiting for Karl to call.

378.speaker: Lucian Galade
378.text: "Here. It's all in the report from our intelligence officers."

380.speaker: Lucian Galade
380.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Accepted_MediaDeal"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_Detained_MarcelKoronti"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Relations_Marcel_Enemy"] == false

382.speaker: Player
382.text: "It's okay, Lucian. I know exactly what you mean."

387.speaker: Lucian Galade
387.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_LiviaFired"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_LiviaStays"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_SecretState_ArrestLivia"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_SecretState_Kill_Livia"] == true

388.speaker: Lucian Galade
388.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_LiviaFired"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_LiviaStays"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_SecretState_ArrestLivia"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn08_SecondScandal_SecretState_Kill_Livia"] == true) == false

403.speaker: Player
403.text: "Come to my office. You're making a scene out here."

404.speaker: Player
404.text: "I'll tell you in my office. Feel free to take a moment first."

405.speaker: Narrator
405.text: Once Petr was in my office, I shut the door and explained everything Lucian had told me about Livia.

406.speaker: Petr Vectern
406.text: "And you believed him? Well, better safe than sorry, especially after what she called me..."

407.speaker: Petr Vectern
407.text: "At least we finally have this ordeal behind us. Let's get on with running the country, shall we?"

410.speaker: Player
410.text: "Actually, I have to tell you something..."

414.speaker: Player
414.text: "Lucian wanted you to resign, but I told him it's not happening."

415.speaker: Narrator
415.text: Petr looked up at me. His expression was numb.

416.speaker: Player
416.text: "You look like shit. Why don't you take the rest of the day off?"

418.speaker: Petr Vectern
418.text: "Thanks, Anton. I do need a little time. But I promise it's going to be a whole new me from now on."

423.speaker: Narrator
423.text: A whole new vice president... I didn't have the heart to tell Petr how right he was.

424.speaker: Narrator
424.text: A whole new Petr... I hoped he was right about that.

425.speaker: Petr Vectern
425.text: "I... I guess I deserve this, don't I?"

426.speaker: Player
426.text: "Yes. Your philandering put all of us in danger."

427.speaker: Player
427.text: "No. But we need someone to take the fall for this scandal, or the administration suffers."

428.speaker: Narrator
428.text: He exhaled slowly. I could see tears in his eyes.

429.speaker: Petr Vectern
429.text: "I'm so sorry, Anton. I was never cut out for this job."

431.speaker: Player
431.text: "You really weren't. But at least you got a nice house out of the deal."

432.speaker: Narrator
432.text: Petr looked up at me with an indignant expression.

433.speaker: Petr Vectern
433.text: "Of course he does, that fink. Did you tell him off?"

434.speaker: Player
434.text: "Actually, I agree with him. I'm announcing your resignation, Petr."

435.speaker: Player
435.text: "I did. We're laying this all at Rumburg's feet."

436.speaker: Player
436.text: "I did. This is as much my fault as it is yours. The administration will take the hit."

437.speaker: Narrator
437.text: Petr looked up at me in surprise.

439.speaker: Narrator
439.text: Petr's face fell. He seemed to sink into the couch.

440.speaker: Player
440.text: "We're laying this all at Rumburg's feet."

441.speaker: Player
441.text: "This is as much my fault as it is yours. The administration will take the hit."

442.speaker: Narrator
442.text: Petr eagerly nodded, then thought better of it and shook his head.

443.speaker: Petr Vectern
443.text: "No. My drunken idiocy got us into this mess in the first place."

444.speaker: Petr Vectern
444.text: "It's going to be a whole new me from now on, Anton. I promise."

445.speaker: Petr Vectern
445.text: "I can't believe I was so careless."

446.speaker: Petr Vectern
446.text: "That's... wow. I can't believe you'd do that for me."

447.speaker: Petr Vectern
447.text: "Oof. I hope they don't take it as a sign to escalate. But, wow, thanks for protecting me from Guillotine Galade over there."

448.speaker: Petr Vectern
448.text: "Unless Evelyn takes it in the divorce."

450.speaker: Player
450.text: "You'll have some time before the news goes public. I suggest you get your affairs in order."

452.speaker: Petr Vectern
452.text: "All right, I get the message. But first..."

453.speaker: Player
453.text: "You did great. Sordland's just not ready for a vice president like you yet."

455.speaker: Player
455.text: "We'll have some time before the news goes public. We should get our stories straight."

457.speaker: Narrator
457.text: Without waiting for him to answer, I poured some whiskey into a glass. Petr grabbed the bottle instead.

459.speaker: Narrator
459.text: He drained a third of the bottle in one long swig, then got to his feet and unsteadily made his way to the door.

460.speaker: Narrator
460.text: He grabbed the bottle of Erlory Maroon 30-Year-Old from the shelf behind my desk.

461.speaker: Narrator
461.text: I knew this was for the best. But I hoped my friend would be all right.

476.speaker: Lucian Galade
476.text: "If made to look like an accident, a covert assassination by your Secret State Police could solve our problem before it even starts. But I understand if you still harbor fond feelings for Miss Vance."
